limitations: Only the eight-drum LLW job is inspected; the hall contains 28 drums.
Detector false positives are retained; conditions need corroboration.
Sensor channels are simulated. A swab measures surface contamination, not structural integrity.

The API calls run synchronously while simulation time is paused; this is not a real-time latency benchmark.
